access.rate: too many recordings, wait a minute
tip.server_url:
WebSocket address of the server, for example wss://vf.example.com/ws.
Unencrypted ws:// is only for a local network.
tip.token: The part after the colon next to your Telegram ID in VF_USERS on the server.
tip.mode:
Addon: the chat never opens; the addon picks the channel (party, raid, dungeon, whisper reply).
Plain chat: no addon; the agent opens the chat with Enter and types /p, /g, /w.
tip.addon_hotkey: The key the agent uses to call the addon. Must match the one /vf shows in the game.
tip.mic:
The agent turns the microphone on only while recording.
“Test” shows the level: normal speech should reach the middle.
tip.ptt_button: The gamepad button that records your voice. While the addon is on, the game doesn't get it. The in-game check shows what was on it before.
tip.ptt_button_chat: Without the addon the game gets this press too. Pick a button that does nothing in the game.
tip.ptt_button_rightstick: In WoW Forever the right stick places pings. The addon takes the button; pings can be rebound in the game's controller settings.
tip.ptt_button_share: The agent sees Share through GameInput: restart the agent after changing the button. The game most likely can't see it, so there may be no recording badge in the game.
tip.ptt_mode:
Toggle: the first press starts recording, the second sends it.
Hold: records while the button is held down.
tip.max_record: Longer recordings stop and are sent automatically.
tip.ptt_sounds: A short sound when recording starts and stops.
tip.bind: Start the game and log in with a character. The agent hands the button to the addon: press it in the game, and the addon remembers the old binding and reloads the interface.
tip.bind_was_on: While the addon is on, it owns the button. The old action can be rebound in the game's controller settings.
tip.game: The agent types only into the active game window. If the game is in the background, a message waits up to {s} s.
tip.account: Your plan on this server. AI messages: Claude picks the channel and fixes the text. When they run out, the channel is picked by keywords until 00:00 UTC.
tip.test: Sends “VoiceForever test” to /say as soon as the game window is active.
tip.game_window: How the agent recognises the game: a matching window title or process name is enough.
tip.detect: Press, then switch to the game within 5 s: the agent adds its window and process.
tip.focus_wait: How long a message waits for the game window to become active. After that it isn't sent.
tip.open_delay: Pause between opening the input box and typing. Raise it if the first letters go missing.
tip.part_delay: A long message goes to chat as several lines; this is the pause between them.
tip.key_delay: Pause between key presses while typing. Raise it if the game drops keys.
tip.language: Changes right away. The Telegram bot has its own: /language.
hotkey.capturing: Press a key combination… Esc to cancel
hotkey.changed: Change it in the game too: /vf key {binding}
mic.no_sdl: SDL3.dll missing: no microphone or gamepad
pad.press: Press a button on the gamepad…
pad.not_running: the gamepad and microphone are not running
pad.stopped: the gamepad and microphone stopped, details in the log
bind.title: In-game check
bind.err_addon_missing_hint: Enable VoiceForever in the AddOns list
bind.err_wrong_button_hint: Run the check again and press {button}
bind.err_no_game_folder_hint: The button is assigned; its old binding is shown in the game chat
bind.intro_chat: No check needed without the addon
bind.d_not_focused: the game window did not become active
bind.d_no_result: no result from the addon, run /reload in the game
badge.skip: Skipped: doesn't look like a chat message
badge.bad_audio: The recording didn't reach the server
badge.unsupported: The server doesn't take voice from the agent
badge.timeout: The server didn't answer in time
badge.error: Not sent, details in the agent window
net.not_websocket: no WebSocket server at this address
net.timeout: the server did not answer within {s} s
net.access_down: the account service is not answering
net.replaced: another agent connected with this token
net.auth: the server did not accept the agent token
net.revoked: the token was revoked on the account page
net.dropped: the connection to the server dropped
net.voice_timeout: the server did not answer in time
net.crashed: internal agent error, details in the log
cfg.server_url: Enter the server address, for example wss://vf.example.com/ws
cfg.server_url_scheme: The address must start with wss:// or ws://
cfg.token: Paste the agent token from VF_USERS on the server
cfg.token_short: Token from VF_USERS: at least {n} characters, no spaces
cfg.hotkey: Needs a key, for example ctrl+shift+f12
cfg.window_or_process: Needs at least one game window title or process
cfg.mic: Needs a microphone name or an empty string
tray.auth: Check the token in the agent settings.
